title: THE BIG GIG (ABC)
tickerText:
WELCOME TO THE BIG GIG! BACK WHEN MULLETS WERE MAGNIFICENT, SHOULDER PADS WERE ENORMOUS AND AUSTRALIAN COMEDY WAS GETTING DELIGHTFULLY OUT OF HAND, THE ABC UNLEASHED SOMETHING SPECIAL!

FROM 1989 TO 1992, THE BIG GIG BROUGHT AUSTRALIA A GLORIOUSLY CHAOTIC MIX OF STAND-UP, SKETCH COMEDY, LIVE MUSIC AND COMPLETE MADNESS.

WITH WENDY HARMER, GLYNN NICHOLAS, JEAN KITTSON AND THE OUTRAGEOUS DOUG ANTHONY ALL-STARS LEADING THE CHARGE, IT WAS ANYTHING BUT ORDINARY TELEVISION.

THE SHOW ALSO HELPED INTRODUCE AUDIENCES TO FUTURE COMEDY FAVOURITES INCLUDING JUDITH LUCY, JIMEOIN, GREG FLEET, LANO AND WOODLEY AND THE UMBILICAL BROTHERS.

REMEMBER VERONICA GLENHUNTLY? THE LAGER BOYS? THE DOUGS CAUSING HAVOC? THIS WAS AUSTRALIAN COMEDY AT ITS MOST INVENTIVE, IRREVERENT AND BEAUTIFULLY UNPREDICTABLE.

SO SETTLE IN, REWIND THE YEARS AND ENJOY THE LAUGHS, THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL NONSENSE THAT MADE THE BIG GIG A CULT CLASSIC!

SOME THINGS REALLY ARE TOO GOOD TO LEAVE IN THE 80S!
